omissions: Omitted the details of Dong Zhuo's coercive enthronement ceremony, imperial edict, and post-coup privileges.
Omitted Dong Zhuo's further abuses and the exact circumstances of Empress Dowager He’s death.
Omitted Chen Gong’s interrogation and the journey details before reaching Lü Boshe’s estate.
unsupported_additions: States that Chen Gong ultimately refrained from killing Cao Cao and abandoned him; the original ends with Chen Gong intending to kill Cao Cao, without resolving what he did.
“假献” suggests Cao Cao deliberately planned a false offering, whereas in the original he improvises the sword offering after being caught.
distortions: “袁绍反废立出京” is awkward and slightly imprecise; Yuan Shao leaves after opposing Dong Zhuo’s plan.
“误听吕家言杀八人” compresses the episode in a way that may imply the household explicitly planned to kill people, whereas they were actually preparing to slaughter a pig.
language_problems: “袁绍反废立出京” is not natural modern Chinese; “袁绍反对废立，离京出逃” would be clearer.
“太后唐妃死” is grammatically compressed and ambiguous; it could be read as one person or as an incomplete coordination.
